candidates.source_name: Javna agencija RS za varstvo konkurence (AVK) — arhiv odločb / decisions archive
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian competition authority publishes full decisions (odločbe), including merger clearances involving banks and payment/processing entities. Merger decisions routinely contain market definitions and market-share estimates for card acquiring, issuing, ATM networks and retail banking that participants otherwise do not disclose.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the odločbe archive index; PDF/HTML extraction; keyword filter on banka, kartic, plačil, bankomat, POS, Bankart, provizij
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from agency site
queries_used: Javna agencija RS za varstvo konkurence odločba banke plačilne kartice provizije
varstvo-konkurence.si odločbe koncentracije plačilni sistem Bankart medbančna provizija

candidates.source_name: AVK — priglašene koncentracije in odločitve (notified concentrations and decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: Running list of notified M&A in Slovenia. Bank/payment-sector notifications (e.g. bank consolidation such as NKBM/Abanka historically) are the earliest public signal of structural change in the SI banking and payments market, ahead of any statistical publication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape of the notification list; diff-based alerting on new bank/payment entries
queries_used: varstvo-konkurence.si odločbe koncentracije plačilni sistem Bankart medbančna provizija

candidates.source_name: AVK — letna poročila (annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual report enumerates cases opened/closed by sector, including consumer-credit and financial-services analyses covering named banks, branches and savings banks; gives caseload counts and sectoral focus that indicate where competition pressure on fees is being examined.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download and text extraction; track series across years
queries_used: AVK letno poročilo 2024 sektorska preiskava bančni sektor Slovenija varstvo konkurence

candidates.source_name: AVK — raziskave (sector inquiries / market studies)
candidates.why_relevant: AVK publishes standalone market studies (it has done so for digital platforms, district heating, etc.). This is the channel where any future study of card fees, acquiring or ATM access would appear, with quantitative market data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch index page for new studies; alert on financial/payment keywords
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from AVK annual report search
queries_used: AVK letno poročilo 2024 sektorska preiskava bančni sektor Slovenija varstvo konkurence

candidates.source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije (ZPS) — primerjalnik bančnih računov in paketov
candidates.why_relevant: Independent consumer-association comparison tool covering ~15 banks and savings banks in Slovenia, with per-bank fee structures for accounts, cards, ATM withdrawals and online banking. Provides bank-level pricing data usable as a proxy for competitive positioning and fee trends.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/periodic capture of public comparator outputs; respect ToS and membership wall; cite rather than bulk-scrape
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije primerjava stroškov bančnih računov

candidates.source_name: ZPS — tržni pregledi in aktualne vsebine (market reviews, consumer rights articles)
candidates.why_relevant: ZPS market reviews cover basic payment account rights, card-fraud handling, and outcomes of consumer disputes with banks; they frequently publish aggregate statistics (e.g. success rates in out-of-court disputes) not available elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/index polling of the aktualne-vsebine and novice sections; keyword filter banka, kartica, bankomat, gotovina, nadomestilo
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije primerjava stroškov bančnih računov
ZBS izvensodno reševanje potrošniških sporov mnenja IRPS banke poročilo

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — Pritožbe uporabnikov finančnih storitev (PUFS) / complaints channel
candidates.why_relevant: Central bank's consumer-complaint intake and its periodic reporting on complaint volumes and themes for payment services; complaint mix is a leading indicator of friction in cards, ATM access and fee practices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page monitoring plus retrieval of linked complaint reports; annual series extraction
queries_used: Banka Slovenije pritožbe uporabnikov plačilnih storitev izvensodno reševanje sporov poročilo

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — Primerjava stroškov nekaterih bančnih storitev za potrošnike (fee comparison publication)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory annual fee-comparison built from banks' mandatory reporting of representative/most-frequently-charged fees. Bank-by-bank tariff data for accounts, cards and ATM withdrawals — the single most quantitative fee dataset in the SI consumer-protection layer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch + table extraction into a per-bank fee time series
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (ZPS query surfaced BS publication)
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije primerjava stroškov bančnih računov

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — IRPS izvensodno reševanje potrošniških sporov, objavljena mnenja
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS is the designated ADR body for banking disputes and publishes anonymised opinions plus annual caseload statistics (e.g. ~119 new requests, 133 of 148 open cases resolved in a recent year). Case narratives expose disputed fee, card-fraud and account-access practices bank by category.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the ADR page for updated MnenjaIRPS PDFs; parse per-case opinions; track annual caseload counts
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from BS complaints page
queries_used: ZBS izvensodno reševanje potrošniških sporov mnenja IRPS banke poročilo zbs-giz.si
Banka Slovenije pritožbe uporabnikov plačilnih storitev izvensodno reševanje sporov poročilo

candidates.source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec RS (IP) — mnenja ZVOP-2/GDPR database
candidates.why_relevant: The DPA's published opinions on bank data processing (ID copies, transaction history access, card data, staff access to accounts) reveal operational practices of Slovenian banks and payment providers that are otherwise undocumented, and flag compliance constraints on data-driven payment products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search-index crawl with keywords banka, plačilna kartica, transakcij, bankomat; store opinion text + date
queries_used: Informacijski pooblaščenec odločbe banke obdelava osebnih podatkov plačilne kartice inšpekcijski

candidates.source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec RS — inšpekcijski nadzor / prijava kršitev (enforcement channel)
candidates.why_relevant: Pointer to IP's inspection and sanction stream and to its annual report, which aggregates inspection counts by sector including finance/banking — a weak-signal indicator of systemic data practices in payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual report PDF retrieval; extract sector-level inspection tables
queries_used: Informacijski pooblaščenec odločbe banke obdelava osebnih podatkov plačilne kartice inšpekcijski

candidates.source_name: Sodna praksa RS — iskalnik sodne prakse (case-law search, VS/VSL/VSM/UPRS)
candidates.why_relevant: Free national case-law database. Judgments on payment services (ZPlaSSIED), unfair contract terms (ZVPot, OZ), disputed fees and card-fraud liability document how fee and access practices are adjudicated, with facts about specific banks' terms.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised GET queries against the SOLR-backed search (q=ZPlaSSIED, nadomestilo, plačilna kartica, bankomat, nepošten pogodbeni pogoj); paginate and store decision texts
queries_used: sodnapraksa.si sodna praksa plačilne storitve nadomestila banka potrošnik sodba

candidates.source_name: Varuh človekovih pravic RS (Ombudsman) — letna poročila
candidates.why_relevant: Ombudsman annual reports carry case narratives on access to banking (basic payment accounts, branch and ATM closures, digital exclusion of elderly/rural users) and have historically flagged unconstitutional banking-law provisions. Weak-signal evidence on cash and branch/ATM access.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download; keyword extraction for banka, bankomat, gotovina, plačilni račun
queries_used: Varuh človekovih pravic letno poročilo dostop do gotovine bankomat banke Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Tržni inšpektorat RS (TIRS) — inspection reports and consumer-protection enforcement
candidates.why_relevant: TIRS supervises consumer protection, unfair commercial practices, unfair contract terms and consumer credit (ZPotK). Its annual business reports give inspection and sanction counts by area (13,324 inspections / 6,587 measures reported for 2023), including consumer-credit intermediation adjacent to payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual poslovno poročilo PDF retrieval from gov.si; extract sector tables
queries_used: Tržni inšpektorat RS letno poročilo potrošniki finančne storitve kršitve

candidates.source_name: Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev (ATVP) — letna poročila and odločitve
candidates.why_relevant: Securities-market regulator supervising banks performing investment services, brokerages and fund managers. Annual reports to Parliament and published decisions (odločitve) reveal sanctions and market-conduct findings against banks; its 'Podatkovno ogledalo' publishes market data.
candidates.source_subtype: financial regulator annual report + decision register
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF retrieval; scrape decisions index; pull the Podatkovno ogledalo data pages
queries_used: Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev ATVP letno poročilo nadzor

candidates.source_name: PIS — Pravno-informacijski sistem RS (pisrs.si) consolidated legislation register
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative consolidated texts of ZPlaSSIED, ZVPot-1, ZPotK-2, ZPOmK-2 and the emerging cash-access law. Needed to interpret which fee, ATM-coverage and complaint disclosures are legally mandated — i.e. which datasets must exist and be published.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted fetch of act pages by ID; monitor amendments
queries_used: pisrs.si Zakon o plačilnih storitvah ZPlaSSIED prekrški nadzor Banka Slovenije javna objava

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS — official gazette (incl. commentary on ZDUPS cash/e-payment rules)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes all adopted acts and secondary regulation, including the constitutional amendment on the right to use cash and the payment-means accessibility act; also carries explanatory commentary. Primary record for regulatory shocks to cash/card acceptance and ATM obligations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Issue-level monitoring with keyword filters gotovina, plačiln, bankomat, potrošnik
queries_used: Zakon o zagotavljanju dostopa do gotovine Slovenija bankomati predlog zakona gov.si

candidates.source_name: e-Uprava / gov.si — javne obravnave predlogov zakonov (public consultation on ZDUPS cash & basic-account law)
candidates.why_relevant: The e-demokracija consultation portal carries draft acts plus stakeholder comments. The ZDUPS draft (ATM within 5 km for settlements >1,000 inhabitants, branch obligation >3,000, free basic package incl. 5 free other-bank ATM withdrawals) is a direct, quantified regulatory constraint on ATM/POS economics; bank and chamber submissions reveal cost data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor e-demokracija listings for MF/Banka Slovenije drafts; download draft + pripombe (comment) documents
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball to chamber commentary
queries_used: Zakon o zagotavljanju dostopa do gotovine Slovenija bankomati predlog zakona gov.si

candidates.source_name: Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije (OZS) — merchant-side commentary on payment regulation
candidates.why_relevant: Crafts and small-business chamber comments on cash-acceptance and card-acceptance obligations from the merchant/acceptor side, often citing merchant service charges and terminal costs — pricing evidence acquirers do not publish.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: News-index polling with keywords POS, kartic, gotovin, plačiln, provizij
queries_used: Zakon o zagotavljanju dostopa do gotovine Slovenija bankomati predlog zakona gov.si

candidates.source_name: Državni zbor RS — legislative record incl. constitutional article 74.a on the right to use cash
candidates.why_relevant: Parliamentary record for the constitutional amendment guaranteeing the right to use cash (new art. 74.a, adopted 67-1) and for the citizens' initiative behind it (56,267 signatures, 'Povezani smo'). Establishes the legal driver for cash-access obligations shaping ATM/branch networks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search the DZ document repository for ustavni zakon / gotovina; pull committee materials and transcripts
queries_used: Ustavno sodišče Slovenija ustavna pravica do plačevanja z gotovino sprememba ustave 2025

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian AVK decision specifically on interchange fees, card scheme rules or merchant service charges was located in searches in sl or en.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only EU-level MasterCard/Visa interchange material and generic AVK pages; the AVK decision archive surfaced non-payment cases. Interchange in SI appears to be governed directly by EU Regulation 2015/751 and handled at EU level rather than by national decisions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The expected 'interchange decision' evidence channel for this cell is likely empty at national level; effort should be redirected to AVK merger decisions and to the BS/EU interchange reporting instead.

negative_findings.description: No publicly published Banka Slovenije statistical series of consumer complaints about payment services (counts by type/provider) was confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: The BS complaints page (PUFS) documents the intake channel and legal framework; a regular published complaints-statistics report was not located in search results. Existence is plausible inside the BS annual report but unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Complaint counts are the core quantitative asset of this cell; if only ZBS/IRPS publishes counts, ADR data becomes the primary complaints series rather than the supervisor's.

negative_findings.description: ZPS comparator results appear to sit partly behind membership; full per-bank fee tables may not be openly retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public ZPS pages describe the comparator and headline conclusions; the detailed questionnaire-driven comparison likely requires membership. Not verified by fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level ZPS fee data may need a subscription or must be substituted by the Banka Slovenije statutory fee comparison, which is fully open.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian financial ombudsman for banking was found; the function is split between Banka Slovenije (supervisory complaints) and ZBS (ADR).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for an ombudsman on fees/access returned the general human-rights Ombudsman (Varuh) and the ZBS ADR body. No sector-specific financial ombudsman institution surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not assume a single ombudsman dataset; the complaints picture must be assembled from BS + ZBS + TIRS + courts.

negative_findings.description: TIRS annual/business report landing URL on gov.si was not directly confirmed in results; only aggregate figures were quoted by secondary pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: 2023 figures (13,324 inspections, 6,587 measures) appeared via secondary summarisation; the canonical gov.si report URL was not returned by search and remains to be located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The TIRS candidate is recorded at the organisation root URL rather than a direct report link; a follow-up pass must resolve the actual report path before automated collection.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level adjudication touching Slovenia (European Commission competition decisions, CJEU/Curia rulings on interchange and payment accounts, EBA consumer-trends and payment-fraud reports) was not systematically covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep of curia.europa.eu, EC DG COMP case register and EBA publications filtered for Slovenian parties or SI-specific data.

coverage_gaps.description: No verification pass was made on AVK's decision-archive pagination depth or on whether older interchange/banking cases sit only in the pre-2013 Urad za varstvo konkurence (UVK) archive under a different domain or naming.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the full odločbe archive index including legacy UVK-era records; search alias terms 'Urad RS za varstvo konkurence', 'UVK'.

coverage_gaps.description: Complaint and dispute data specific to ATM/POS access and card acceptance (as opposed to accounts and credit) is thin; no source found that breaks complaints down by card/ATM/POS category.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse ZBS IRPS opinion PDFs case-by-case to build a home-made category taxonomy (card fraud, ATM withdrawal, fee dispute) and derive counts.

coverage_gaps.description: Second-tier consumer bodies were not explored: Mednarodni inštitut za potrošniške raziskave (MIPOR, ZPS research arm), Zveza potrošnikov' European Consumer Centre Slovenia (ECC-Net SI), and the Ministry of Economy consumer-protection directorate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sl-language sweep on MIPOR, Evropski potrošniški center Slovenija and MGTŠ varstvo potrošnikov for cross-border payment complaint statistics.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live; all entries rest on search-result evidence only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass before any URL is treated as reachable, and re-resolve the two root-level URLs (varuh-rs.si annual reports index, gov.si TIRS) which were inferred from result context.

brief: Slovenia's non-central-bank regulatory and consumer-protection layer is fragmented but unusually rich in fee-level evidence. The highest-value quantitative assets are the statutory Banka Slovenije fee-comparison series and the ZPS comparator (bank-by-bank pricing for accounts, cards and ATM withdrawals), backed by ZBS's IRPS out-of-court dispute opinions and caseload counts, which are the only public complaints statistics found for banking. AVK contributes market-structure evidence through merger decisions and its odločbe archive rather than through interchange enforcement — no national interchange decision was found, which is itself a finding. The most consequential live thread is the legislative one: the new constitutional right to use cash (art. 74.a) and the draft ZDUPS with hard ATM-coverage and free-basic-package obligations, whose consultation file on gov.si carries industry cost submissions unavailable anywhere else.
